facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment

control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.title: energy isolation failure on TK-7102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the secondary containment by bund and drainage on TK-7102 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. TK-7102 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 16 May 2020 an incident occurred on TK-7102 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during commissioning of replacement equipment, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
